## Change

Describe the precise requested change. Is this an export, a correction or an explicitly authorised redesign?

## LORE preflight

- [ ] Read AGENTS.md and current brand/brand-lock.json.
- [ ] Used only approved brand lines; no old suggestions or incidental generated copy.
- [ ] Reused the same crown and lettering components across colourways.
- [ ] No unsourced moments or unapproved partnership claims.
- [ ] Opened actual PNGs on dark and light backgrounds.
- [ ] Crown tips/base, brush tips, alpha, halos, borders and overlaps checked.
- [ ] Recorded dimensions, source revision and file hashes.
- [ ] Separated technical QA, user design approval and production approval.
- [ ] Verified the committed files rather than claiming a local export was uploaded.

## Approval/status

Link the exact proof and approval record. If approval is pending, keep it REVIEW_ONLY and do not add it to approved_exports.
